description: This Java class 'PaymentTypeResolver' provides a method to resolve a payment type by name using the Fineract client API. It retrieves all payment types and finds the one matching the provided name, returning its ID. The class uses Spring annotations for caching and component registration.

classes.name: PaymentTypeResolver
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that resolves payment type IDs based on payment type name by querying the Fineract payment type API.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns the ID of the given PaymentType by querying the payment types via API and matching by name.
